evidence.ACL: R/O mucoid degenration and partial tear of AXL.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear and blurring hyperintensity in the posterior horn of medial meniscus with articular surface disruption, in favor of longitudinal tear
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Mild increased intensity in the lateral meniscus, in favor intrasubstance degeneration
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing articular cartilage of knee joint with large spur formation and tiny subchondral cysts, more severe at medial compartment, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.Lateral OA: Wearing articular cartilage of knee joint with large spur formation and tiny subchondral cysts, more severe at medial compartment, reflecting osteoarthritis.
evidence.PF OA: Focal increased intensity in the patellar cartilage with fissure and tiny subchondral cyst, more prominent at medial side, in favor of grade 4 chondral injury.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: in favor of small Baker's cyst.
